stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Kristian Bonetti - great to have Mollymook GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 2 marker sitting 9th

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.detail: 9 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 17, 1-pointer on hole 18

stories.title: The Flat White Round
stories.detail: 7 twos in a row on holes 12-18 - reliable, consistent, zero drama

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 17 & 18 - this is momentum

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 14-18 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 14-18

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 19, back nine 6 - the tank hit empty

comingLast.roast: deadlocked with Holle for the double blue - the bar has picked sides
tied with O'Connell - two men, two blue balls, maths pending
1 above O'Connell from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
finished 3 above the blue line - toasting every point O'Connell does not score
done and dangling 4 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
5 above O'Connell and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
safe by 5 unless the course gets generous late
